sentences.text: When fire breaks out, raise the alarm, get life jackets on everyone, and move passengers away from the fire.
Maneuver the boat so the wind carries smoke and flames away from people, which often means putting the fire downwind.
Use a portable extinguisher with PASS: pull the pin, aim at the base of the fire, squeeze the handle and sweep side to side.
Keep an escape route behind you.
Small boat fires grow very fast, so if the fire isn’t out within seconds, call Mayday and prepare to abandon the boat.
